name: Brand Connector Pro
description: Finds and verifies a company's social media profiles from its website URL, with evidence for each handle.

authentication.notes: MCP requests need an OAuth 2.0 bearer token; requests without one get HTTP 401. Accounts must complete two-factor (authenticator app) before access is granted.

skills.name: Look up socials
skills.description: Find a company's social media profiles from its website address, with evidence for each match.

skills.name: List my lookups
skills.description: List the signed-in user's 50 most recent saved website lookups.

skills.name: List my lists
skills.description: List the signed-in user's saved lists with how many sites each holds.
